subject.title: feat(plugins): support per-agent plugin installation with --agent flag

question: Should OpenClaw expose agent-scoped plugin installation now, and if so what security and lifecycle contract must it satisfy before merge?
rationale: This changes plugin code placement and persisted install identity, so automation cannot safely choose the trust, precedence, validation, migration, and runtime-discovery semantics.

options.title: Complete Lifecycle Contract First
options.body: Require the PR to implement scoped install identity across install, uninstall, update, registry/index, discovery, doctor, docs, and validation before exposing the flag.

options.title: Pause For Product Design
options.body: Keep the branch open but paused while maintainers decide whether per-agent plugin installs belong in core and what threat model applies.

options.title: Reject This Core Surface
options.body: Close or redirect this direction if maintainers want per-agent plugin variants handled outside core or through a different plugin API.

recommendation.title: Complete Lifecycle Contract First
recommendation.body: Require the PR to implement scoped install identity across install, uninstall, update, registry/index, discovery, doctor, docs, and validation before exposing the flag.

likelyOwner.reason: History points to repeated plugin lifecycle and install-policy work by this owner, and the decision spans the plugin control-plane boundary.
